description: 한국가스공사_용수사용량 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국가스공사. 데이터 구성항목은 2014년부터 2020년까지의 연도별 해수, 상수도, 지하수 사용량(㎥ 단위)으로 이루어져 있어 용수원별 사용현황을 종합적으로 파악할 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국가스공사. Its tags are 해수, 상수도, 지하수, 사용량, 연간. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
